faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about the invoi platform and how it works.
faq.q1Title: What types of invoices does the system support?
faq.q1Desc: The system currently provides full support for incoming invoices received from suppliers and expenses only.
faq.q2Title: What file formats are supported for uploading invoices?
faq.q2Desc: You can easily upload invoices either as images (JPG / PNG) or PDF files to start the automatic extraction process.
faq.q3Title: Does the system support Arabic invoices?
faq.q3Desc: Yes, the system fully and equally supports invoices in both Arabic and English from day one without any difference in processing quality.
faq.q4Title: How does the system ensure data accuracy and security?
faq.q4Desc: AI automatically extracts data, with a review system that flags and alerts on any field to ensure manual review and full control before approval.
